messages:
kim: Quick sync: scheduling v2 public rollout tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. Canary plan 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m watch windows. Need compatibility gate, release notes, and explicit rollback criteria. Alex, can you confirm mobile SDK header behavior?

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled 2026-03-25 09:00 PT. Canary steps: 5%, 25%, 100%. Preflight checks: schema lint, health endpoints green, baseline p95 latency. Canary error threshold: 0.5% 5xx across 15m. Rollback trigger: any 15m window >1% 5xx or sustained >2x latency.

alex: Quick findings: iOS SDKs older than 1.4.2 don't always send X-Client-Version. Android and newer iOS are OK. Options: emit header via a small client hotfix, or route older SDKs to v1. I'll try a lightweight shim but no promises for legacy pinned clients.

maria: Infra check: autoscaling and capacity buffers OK for canary traffic. I'll prepare a gateway routing rule to send clients without acceptable X-Client-Version to v1. Also adding a runtime feature flag to flip v2 routing instantly.

kim: Good. We should reserve a short changelog blurb and partner note. @release-notes-bot can you draft copy that mentions header requirement and fallback behavior?

release-notes-bot: Draft: "v2 rollout introduces protocol improvements and routing behavior. Clients must send X-Client-Version or Accept-Version; clients older than 1.4.2 will be routed to v1 automatically. See internal migration guide: https://redwood.internal/release/v2 for steps and timelines."

sre-oncall: Oncall playbook: pause rollout and revert routing to baseline if rollback triggers hit. If second attempt also fails, full rollback and incident escalation. Monitoring: 15m sliding windows with alerting on 5xx and latency deviations.

alex: I'll open a tiny PR to add header emission to older iOS SDK builds and stage it to canary. ETA 6h. If not feasible, routing rule becomes source of truth.

maria: Routing rule (will deploy to canary gateway cluster first):
```
if request.headers.get('X-Client-Version') and version_ge(request.headers['X-Client-Version'], '1.4.2'):
    route('/v2')
elif request.headers.get('Accept-Version') and version_ge(request.headers['Accept-Version'], '1.4.2'):
    route('/v2')
else:
    route('/v1')
```
I'll paste final config into the ops runbook once deployed.

kim: I'll create the change-window doc and checklist: owners for each canary step, partner comms, and immediate rollback steps. Post-rollout: 30m intensified monitoring then close. If we spot clients pinned to v1 that should be on v2, call it out here so we can whitelist.

deploy-bot: Preflight passed. No blocking alerts. Ready for rollout.

alex: Pushed partner note to the partners channel with header guidance. Maria, ping here when routing is live so we can update the runbook.

maria: Will do. Deploying to canary cluster in 10m, then promote if green.

kim: Thanks everyone. Proceeding with the plan. :thumbsup:
